Ashoka's Rock Edict XIII names the Andhras among the peoples within his empire. Pillar Edict VII, Minor Rock Edict I and Rock Edict II do not carry this reference.
Vaishya Tekri near Ujjain (Avanti's capital on the Sipra) is a BCE stupa bigger than Sanchi; it yielded punch-marked and cast Avanti coins, and its excavation is to resume after about 90 years.
